rationale.direct-roster-and-token-backed-surfaces: CHOSEN. The operator can search and open a coworker immediately from a compact, progressively paged directory; metrics compose the shared reporting palette; and both canvases resolve the active DPF theme. The existing routes, data sources, roster semantics, and graph interactions stay authoritative.
rationale.default-open-directory-disclosure: REJECTED. Opening the disclosure by default would reveal the roster but retain a collapse control with no useful outcome and preserve an extra interaction concept around the page's primary task.
rationale.preserve-current-disclosure: REJECTED. The closed disclosure reproduces the reported extra click and prevents search or roster scanning on arrival. Hard-coded canvas and table colors also remain unreadable whenever their assumed theme differs from the active theme.

notes: Fits with guardrails. Platform owns Operational Metrics and Graph Explorer; Business owns AI Coworkers. The change removes one redundant link and one primary-content disclosure, gives the shared RosterView a compact directory presentation with bounded first-page results, adds no route or navigation layer, centralizes only CSS-token-to-Canvas2D translation, and preserves honest empty states.
